# Quirkwell

> Quirkwell makes oddly specific, funny retro t-shirt and gift designs, sold on Redbubble and TeePublic. This site is a gift guide; every product is printed, sold and shipped by Redbubble or TeePublic.

## Gift guides

- [Funny Christmas shirts and gift ideas (2026)](https://quirkwell.com/funny-christmas-shirts.html): Funny Christmas t-shirts and gifts for 2026: a T-rex Christmas tree, a UFO abducting a Christmas tree, a corgi in wrapping paper, a Christmas goose and matching family cookie shirts.
- [Gifts for dog lovers, cat lovers and bookworms](https://quirkwell.com/gifts-for-dog-and-cat-lovers.html): Funny and cute gifts for dog moms, corgi lovers, cat moms and bookworms: t-shirts, hoodies, mugs and stickers.
- [Funny gifts for introverts, overthinkers and coworkers](https://quirkwell.com/gifts-for-introverts-and-overthinkers.html): Relatable funny shirts and mugs for introverts, overthinkers, night owls and tired coworkers: Social Battery 1%, Overthinkers Athletic Club and Greetings From Burnout.
- [Space nerd gifts: retro planet national park shirts](https://quirkwell.com/space-nerd-gifts.html): Retro space travel poster shirts and gifts for astronomy lovers and hikers: Saturn National Park, Mars National Park and a UFO Christmas design.
